subject: Supplier invite failing: device bind error preventing PO creation
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@sunset-systems.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@sunset-systems.com
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood portal invite — hitting device-binding error

Hi Lauren,

We clicked the invite sent yesterday (Zip link) but the flow gets stuck during "device binding" with an error: "Failed to bind device: invalid challenge response". The UI then shows an empty spinner and no next step. We tried in Chrome and Safari, cleared cookies, and retried on an incognito window. Same result.

This is blocking our ability to accept the invite and set up the billing contact so we can receive POs. Can you reissue the invite or advise a workaround? I can share a screenshot and the debug log if helpful.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Moreno
Procurement Lead, Sunset Systems
procurement@sunset-systems.com

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood portal invite — hitting device-binding error

Alex — thanks for the quick note and the log. Sorry you're blocked.

Quick summary of what I'll do:
- Reissue a fresh invite from Zip with a longer TTL and a different token format (we've seen some clients hit truncated token issues when our proxy inserts an extra param).
- Ask Ben to check for any tenant alias collisions in the activation path that could cause a bad challenge to be returned.
- If needed, we can create a temporary manual vendor record so you can receive the first PO while we resolve the invite flow.

Ben / Marissa — FYI. Ben, can you triage the token binding logs (I attached the customer's debug file) and confirm whether this looks like a proxy trimming issue or an IDP attr mismatch? If it's an easy fix, please reissue and paste the one-time link here so I can send it to Alex. If it will take longer than 2 hours, let's provision the vendor manually so procurement isn't blocked.

Alex — if you can, please reply with the screenshot and the browser console lines around the error (the attached txt helped). We'll treat this as high priority.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@sunset-systems.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 12:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood portal invite — hitting device-binding error

Forwarding findings from runtime:

On stages: device-binding step returns a 400 from our token-exchange endpoint with payload: "invalid_challenge". Looking at the invite link Alex pasted into the debug log, our proxy appended the query param _ga=1.2.x.y to the URL; on some Zip token formats the challenge is encoded as the last fragment and our Nginx rule was stripping fragments when redirecting through the marketing gateway.

Immediate actions taken (done):
- Reissued a new invite link from Zip (one-time token, TTL 72h) that uses an auth param instead of fragment. Link: https://zip.redwood.ai/invite/eyJ0eXAi.*** (sent privately to Lauren).
- Added a temporary Nginx rule to preserve URL fragments when proxying invites (will need a proper fix in infra next week).

Suggested short-term workaround: If Alex still sees problems, we'll manually onboard the vendor in Redwood Console under Procurement > Vendors and attach W-9 / registration docs. That will allow creation of a PO immediately.

Marissa — can you coordinate manual vendor creation and attach the W-9 once Alex confirms? Also flag this for a post-mortem (token encoding + proxy behavior).

Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
[internal note: infra ticket INF-2028-492 created]
